control_failures.control_label: emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment
integrity of the mechanical seal support system

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: high potential incident during cleaning and preparation on P-7113

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment on P-7113 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment, specifically replacing seals and seal support fluid. P-7113 (export transfer pumps) is in service for tank-to-jetty product transfer, same seal class as the Marrindal family. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was not in place. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 27 September 2023 a high potential incident was recorded on P-7113 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during cleaning and preparation; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
